features: dual-lens ball + bullet design (3MP + 3MP), dual-picture monitoring
pan-tilt auto tracking, motion + human + sound detection
IR + color night vision to 20 m (22x 3030 IR LEDs, IR-CUT)
two-way audio (built-in mic + 2W speaker, 100 dB), buzzer alarm
